The VIP Champions in attendance here this weekend will enter the tournament momentarily thanks to their two rounds of free byes, but before they do, let’s take a look at this year’s World Championship Qualifier trophies.

These trophies will be awarded to the Top 8 in the all-ages World Championship Qualifier: the yellow trophies are for Quarterfinalists; the green will go to Semifinalists in the Top 4; the blue trophy will go home with the Runner-Up Finalist; and the red trophy – the largest of them all – is reserved for the new Central American Champion.

If you remember last year’s WCQ trophies these may look familiar. Even the colors are a tradition. But this year each trophy’s accompanied by a light-up LED base, which makes them glow like never before. It’s a nice touch, and it’s attracting a lot of attention here this weekend.
The Top 4 Dragon Duel WCQ finishers will earn trophies as well, in the same colors and with the same light-up LED base tech. Cool stuff!

A lot of different trophies have been awarded for different contests across the history of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, but that illumination effect really pushes this year’s trophies to new heights. They’re gonna make an awesome addition to whatever mantle they wind up on.

With just two more rounds left in the tournament today, now’s a great time to look at the top tables and see what Decks are currently doing the best. In any Swiss-style tournament, the most successful competitors are grouped together to play against each other; that way everyone competes against players with equal records, and roughly similar skill levels. As a Duelist racks up more and more points over the course of a tournament, they’re pushed further and further toward Table Number 1, with the lowest table numbers the exclusive domain of undefeateds.

That means that once a tournament’s been going for a while, you can get a very accurate snapshot of which Decks are dominating the field just by looking at the top tables. And if you were here today and did that yourself, here’s what you’d see.
